facts.summary: Phase 3 RELIANCE I missed primary endpoint on placebo response · Phase 3 · REL-1017 in adjunctive major depressive disorder · not yet approved

evidence.summary: the study did not achieve its primary endpoint, which was a statistically significant improvement in depression symptoms compared to placebo as measured by the Montgomery-Asberg Depression Rating Scale (MADRS) on Day 28
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: the study did not achieve its primary endpoint, which was a statistically significant improvement in depression symptoms compared to placebo as measured by the Montgomery-Asberg Depression Rating Scale (MADRS) on Day 28
evidence.safety: REL-1017, as it did in RELIANCE III, demonstrated very favorable tolerability and safety in RELIANCE I
evidence.program_discontinued: Relmada continues to enroll patients in RELIANCE II, the second ongoing Phase 3, two-arm, placebo-controlled, pivotal study evaluating REL-1017 as a potential adjunctive treatment for MDD.
